Cartulary_instruction: Every user action has keyboard operation; preserve logical order and no traps.
Use Cartulary focus tokens; never remove focus without an accessible replacement.
Pair every semantic color with text, shape, marker, icon, or accessible name.
Icon-only controls require stable semantic icon ID, accessible name, and visible focus.
State remains understandable with motion disabled; motion never blocks input.
Show validation and recovery at the affected cell/editor/inspector section.
Distinguish loading, refresh, successful empty, filtered empty, unavailable, unauthorized, stale, and failure.
Every actionable failure exposes an owner-permitted retry, edit, discard, or help path.
Keep workbook rows virtualized at all result sizes; preserve stable row identity and focus.
Avoid shell/grid layout jumps and keep prior authorized rows during background refresh.
Use docs/design.md token, theme, density, icon, and component registries only.
Inspect manifests/source; never assume React, Tailwind, shadcn, or another stack.
Use semantic elements/roles and disabled/read-only semantics rather than inert styled containers.
Preserve shell navigation, current-state cues, scroll/filter/input state, and safe account menu access.
Translate applicable review checks into owner-aligned behavior, accessibility, and visual evidence.
Apply only to a future/current touch profile or genuinely touch-oriented controls; do not inflate dense desktop grid rows unconditionally.
Use Cartulary's declared desktop viewport bands and inline-size algorithm; mobile is future-profile work.
Prevent shell overflow; retain legitimate horizontal workbook-grid scrolling within its owned region.
Apply to supported mobile/touch profiles; current dense desktop typography follows Cartulary tokens and contrast/readability requirements.
Use neutral non-record loading structure only where unambiguous; never render fake authoritative workbook rows.
Use Cartulary motion tokens only when motion conveys meaning; preserve reduced-motion and interruptibility.
Apply at a local decision locus; do not distort workbook hot paths into screen-level conversion flows.
Map package icons behind Cartulary semantic icon IDs; package names never become product or test concepts.
In grid/editor contexts place feedback at the affected locus without forcing form layout.
Follow Core-owned rollback/destructive semantics and inspector workflow; avoid generic modal ceremony.
Preserve dense graphite forensic workspace; no cyberpunk visual identity.
Preserve Cartulary color/token registry and scarce warm accent.
Do not invent threat maps, decorative heatmaps, real-time alert theater, or motion.
Do not replace design.md or persist generated MASTER.md/pages overrides.
Do not apply marketing information architecture to the workbook shell.
Keep active workbook grid above administrative or dashboard-card layouts.
No cinematic gradients, glow, parallax, or decorative motion in the live workbook shell.
